native_title: 呪いの制裁は異常班にお任せください

titles.title: 呪いの制裁は異常班にお任せください

description:
Seven years ago, a website called “Josam Mosa” suddenly appeared online, gaining notoriety for selling various spells, curses, and occult tools that supposedly have **real** effects.

Since the emergence of “Josam Mosa,” bizarre and inexplicable incidents have been rapidly increasing everywhere. At the same time, within the police force, the existence of the “Abnormal Phenomena Task Force” (commonly called the AP Team), once dismissed as nothing more than an urban legend, begins to surface.

With the surge in cases involving supernatural entities, the AP Team is busier than ever - and at the center of keeping it all running is Director Yoon Haru.

Then one day, a super-elite rookie named Gio, who seems capable of just about anything, joins the team.
But from his very first week on the job, Gio suddenly confesses that he has feelings for Haru, giving him a constant headache…

---
